description: React component implementing the Multiverse Explorer UI for selecting paths, viewing role recommendations, and exploring mindmaps in a career navigation app.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, handling null/undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a sanitized array of strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRec
methods.description: Generates a role ID from a recommendation object, with fallback to a slugified title.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRec
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a recommendation object.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given path type.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a description for a given path type.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Checks if a string matches a valid path type.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Filters paths based on query, industry, and skills.

methods.name: PathCard
methods.description: React component rendering a clickable path card with bookmark toggle.

methods.name: PathDetailPanel
methods.description: React component showing details of a selected path, including steps and bookmarks.

methods.name: normalizeBackendBookmarksToLocal
methods.description: Converts backend bookmark records to local bookmark objects, sorted by creation date.

methods.name: normalizeRecommendedRoles
methods.description: Normalizes backend recommended roles data into a consistent array of role objects.
